description: Open dataset of freelance payout fees: platform commission, withdrawal channel fees, and foreign-exchange spreads per payout corridor (USD, EUR and GBP base rails). Sovereign coverage: 187 of the 195 sovereign jurisdictions resolve to a corridor. The 8 excluded jurisdictions (BY, CU, IR, KP, MM, RU, SY, VE) are sanctioned or non-convertible markets and are deliberately not priced. The 5 remaining USD-denominated states (US, FM, MH, PW, TL) settle in the dataset's own base currency and resolve by currency identity rather than a degenerate 1.0-rate route.
disclaimer: Rates and fee schedules are indicative aggregates compiled from public merchant/commercial rate cards and are not quotes or guaranteed mid-market rates. Always confirm live rates and fees with your provider before transacting. Per-row provenance: corridors marked rateSource=scraped carry a scraped reference rate, while corridors marked rateSource=modelled carry an authored indicative rate for a currency with no published wholesale feed. For ERN, LYD, SDG, SOS, SSP, YER and ZWL the modelled rate is an official administrated rate, not an observable wholesale market rate, and will diverge from the parallel rate.
